Fellows as the producers of *Big Jim McLain*, and confirmed that John Wayne acted in *True Grit*. However, the Planner wrongly attributed Robert M. Fellows and *True Grit* and relied on an unsupported assumption. The mistake occurred due to insufficient validation of intermediate information and logical jumps that incorrectly linked Fellows to an acting role in *True Grit*.
